articles.summary: TPV surpassed US$14 billion for the first time (+73% year-over-year), six consecutive quarters of 50%+ year-over-year growth. Record gross profit: US$119 million (+40% year-over-year). Operating profit US$57 million excluding prior years tax adjustments (+25% year-over-year).
articles.title: dLocal Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
